content:
Alejandro Ruiz: Heads-up  client MedVault wants an on-prem air-gapped POC. Key asks: signed minibundles, quarterly baseline updates + emergency CVE path, BYO-HSM support, and whether we bill a sealed-environment surcharge. They attached a 32Q security questionnaire.

Sanaa Malik: Clarifying Qs: 1) Preferred transport: secure courier USB vs encrypted SD card? 2) Max minibundle size from their logistics team? 3) For POC do they want us to sign or provide signing tooling?

Alejandro Ruiz: For initial POC they prefer we sign and courier. Logistics asks for <220MB per minibundle. Long-term they want self-signing.

Jon Park: Tech notes: we can produce delta-signed bundles + Notary v2 manifests and SBOMs. BYO-HSM supported via KMIP; if they need us to manage keys for the POC, we'll require an HSM custody addendum and chain-of-custody docs for couriered media. Emergency CVE: we can prepare an offline hotfix bundle and courier within 48-72h under an SLA. Artifact ETA if requirements locked: 12 business days.

Priya (Security): Security constraints: telemetry off by default; supply SBOM and signed build attestations. Third-party pentests allowed with NDA and scoped window. Confirm retention period for manifests (default 5y). Need legal input on courier chain docs.

Hannah (Solutions): Preliminary pricing sketch: one-time POC packaging & signing: $10,000; POC support (2 weeks): $3,500; emergency hotfix SLA addendum: $4,000; sealed-environment monthly maintenance: $2,200/mo; HSM custody or physical courier handling addendum: $5,000 one-time. Estimates until SQ answers.

Alejandro Ruiz: Can someone draft a short SOW skeleton + an SQ checklist and a one-pager explaining Notary verification for their infra team?

Sanaa Malik: I'll draft the SOW and checklist. Items I need from MedVault: transport choice, max minibundle size confirmation, signing preference (us vs self), security contact for pen test coordination, retention period, and whether reproducible builds are required.

Jon Park: If they confirm courier + our signing and no custom runtime patches during build window, 12 business day ETA is realistic. BYO-HSM onboarding + tests add ~4 business days.

deploy-bot: "MedVault airgap POC kickoff" scheduled Apr 11 09:30 PT. Invites sent. :calendar:

Alejandro Ruiz: Great  I'll collect their SQ answers and post here. :thumbsup:
